blocks.p: We do not use analytics, advertising, social-media or other third-party cookies, tracking pixels or similar technologies, and the application loads no third-party scripts or fonts. If that changes, this policy will be updated and your choice will be asked for before any optional cookie is set.

Because these cookies and storage items are needed for the application to work, they cannot be switched off in the application. You can delete them in your browser settings; you will then be signed out and your display choices will be reset.
